ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Studently uses the camera to scan QR codes and to take photos for profiles, attachments and inspection evidence.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Studently needs access to your photos to upload pictures such as profile photos, attachments and inspection evidence.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Studently uses the microphone to record your reading in Speed Reading and voice notes during inspections.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Studently checks the words you read aloud in Speed Reading.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Studently uses your location to set the school check-in area and to confirm on-site attendance.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Studently uses Face ID to unlock the app and to protect sensitive information.
